name: AgentNest
summary: Scans your Shopify catalogue for the product-data gaps AI shopping surfaces trip over (status, category, description, image alt text) and applies the eligible ones in a click. Launched 6 August 2026 with no reviews yet.
best_for: stores that want an outside read on whether their product data is complete enough for AI shopping surfaces: on the free tier, which gives the entire diagnosis at no cost and no commitment
skip_if: you want a track record before you let an app edit your catalogue, you need a billing unit you can count in advance, or your bulk edits are already handled by Shopify's own editor or an app you pay for
honest_knock:
Two months old and still no reviews. The app launched on 6 August 2026; on 9 October 2026 the listing still showed zero reviews, which is not a criticism so much as the plain state of the evidence. Everything below is read off the listing, because there is nothing else to read.

The score is the vendor's own. 'AI shopping readiness' is measured by AgentNest against AgentNest's criteria, and no external standard: no schema.org profile, no Google Merchant Center specification, no published rubric: is named anywhere on the listing. A number that only one company calculates is a prompt to go look at your catalogue, not a fact about your catalogue. On the same page Shopify shows ListingLens and StoreBeam doing the same job, also on free plans.

And the billing unit is defined by the party doing the billing. You pay per 'successful automated fix', with no definition of a fix and no definition of successful. Combined with permissions that let it edit products, collections and files across your store, the sensible way in is: run the free scan, read the issue list, fix a handful yourself, and only then decide whether the one-click version is worth 19 cents a go. The same developer's other app, AskNest, has one review in three months: this is a two-app studio finding its feet, not an established catalogue tool.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for 100 successful automated fixes, billed in USD every 30 days
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-09 on apps.shopify.com/agentnest; first read 2026-08-19, no amount or allowance changed in between, though the listing now calls the app 'AgentNest - ChatGPT Ad Catalog' and pitches the scan as preparation for ChatGPT Ads) Four tiers, and the split between them is unusual: the diagnosis is free and you pay only for the repairs. Free: unlimited catalogue scans, a catalogue readiness score, product-level issue reports and the full findings view. Starter $19 a month: 100 successful automated fixes a month, one-click fixes for all eligible issues, product-level recommendations. Growth $49 a month: 1,000 fixes a month, revenue-priority catalogue insights, fix history and progress tracking. Scale $99 a month: 5,000 fixes a month, advanced revenue-priority insights and bulk catalogue fixes. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days, and no tier shows a free trial. The billing unit is a 'successful automated fix', and the listing never defines it. Whether one fix is one product, one field on one product, or one alt text on one image is the difference between $19 covering a hundred products and a hundred images. It is also the only variable separating the three paid tiers. Developer Ecommerce Storez, 1255 23rd St NW, Washington DC; the app launched on 6 August 2026 and has no reviews at all.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested AgentNest on a Shopify development store on the Free plan: the install, the approval of the Free plan ($0, no card), five clicks on Run first catalog scan that gave no score, no issue list and no message, the Usage and Billing page and the Revenue page (Not imported). Starter $19, Growth $49 and Scale $99 were Not available on dev stores, so what one fix counts as was not tested. The app asked to view and edit store data already on Free. Nothing was paid and the app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the App Store listing (English) was opened and the install form was submitted in our own tab at 18:07; the Shopify dialog Install app asked for View customer data (device and activity data), View staff and contributor data (store owner) and View and edit store data (products, orders, Shopify admin), and Install was clicked. The app opened on Welcome to AgentNest with a button Run first catalog scan, a button Upgrade plan and a score that reads -- out of 100. The admin was in English. No account on the vendor site, password, card or phone number was asked. Core action, the first catalog scan: the button Run first catalog scan was clicked once before a plan was chosen (about 18:08), with no visible reaction. After the Free plan was chosen it was clicked four more times, five times in all until about 18:10. The button turned grey for a moment and then active again. After a reload and after waiting more than 10 seconds the dashboard still showed -- out of 100, of 0 products have critical issues, of 0 products have 1-click fixes and of 0 products require your input. There was no error message, no notice and no scan result. Time to a first result: not reached. Steps: 3 (install, plan, scan). Why the scan gave nothing is not known; it can be a limit of a development store or a fault of the app, and it was not tried again on another store. Revenue page: Not imported, Revenue import required, status NOT_STARTED, 0 qualifying orders and Affected product revenue $0.00; the import was not started. Plans: the Shopify screen Select a plan has Free to test (these plans are free to test on this store; regular pricing applies when the store goes live) with the Free card (Unlimited catalog scans, Catalog readiness score, Product-level issue reports, View catalog findings), and Unavailable on dev stores (these plans can't be selected while the store is in development) with Starter $19 / 30 days (100 successful automated fixes a month), Growth $49 / 30 days (1,000) and Scale $99 / 30 days (5,000), each with a greyed out button Not available. The prices agree with the dossier and the listing. Checkout: the only approval screen was for the Free plan: Approve charge, Plan Free, This plan is free. You will not be billed. It was approved (an exception of $0) and no card or payment method was asked. The paid plans could not be selected on the development store, so no Shopify approval screen for a paid plan, no test charge sentence, no tax and no renewal term were seen. Usage and Billing: Current plan Free, Unlimited scans and reports with no AgentNest-applied fixes, Successful fixes 0, Upgrade to apply fixes, a reset on 17 Dec 2026, the sentence that product updates already applied by AgentNest are not reversed after a downgrade or uninstall, and the sentence that AgentNest does not collect payment details. Permissions: already on the Free plan the app asked to view and edit store data (products, orders, Shopify admin), although the Free plan has no applied fixes. Cancelling: on the Free plan there is no paid subscription. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app and Uninstall; the dialog says that you can no longer use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; a reason is required (we chose Testing multiple apps). Not tested: the automatic fixes (paid plans only, not available on the development store), so also what counts as one fix; the scan result, the readiness score and the issue list, because the scan gave nothing; the revenue import and the ChatGPT Ads link. Clean up: the app was uninstalled after the test and left the list of installed apps; our own tabs were closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The first scan gave no result after five clicks and no message; the Free plan already asked for rights to edit store data; the paid plans cannot be selected on a development store, so the unit of a fix was not tested; and the revenue import was not started.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested AgentNest on a Shopify development store on the Free plan: the install, the approval of the Free plan ($0, no card), five clicks on Run first catalog scan that gave no score, no issue list and no message, the Usage and Billing page and the Revenue page (Not imported). Starter $19, Growth $49 and Scale $99 were Not available on dev stores, so what one fix counts as was not tested. The app asked to view and edit store data already on Free. Nothing was paid and the app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the App Store listing (English) was opened and the install form was submitted in our own tab at 18:07; the Shopify dialog Install app asked for View customer data (device and activity data), View staff and contributor data (store owner) and View and edit store data (products, orders, Shopify admin), and Install was clicked. The app opened on Welcome to AgentNest with a button Run first catalog scan, a button Upgrade plan and a score that reads -- out of 100. The admin was in English. No account on the vendor site, password, card or phone number was asked. Core action, the first catalog scan: the button Run first catalog scan was clicked once before a plan was chosen (about 18:08), with no visible reaction. After the Free plan was chosen it was clicked four more times, five times in all until about 18:10. The button turned grey for a moment and then active again. After a reload and after waiting more than 10 seconds the dashboard still showed -- out of 100, of 0 products have critical issues, of 0 products have 1-click fixes and of 0 products require your input. There was no error message, no notice and no scan result. Time to a first result: not reached. Steps: 3 (install, plan, scan). Why the scan gave nothing is not known; it can be a limit of a development store or a fault of the app, and it was not tried again on another store. Revenue page: Not imported, Revenue import required, status NOT_STARTED, 0 qualifying orders and Affected product revenue $0.00; the import was not started. Plans: the Shopify screen Select a plan has Free to test (these plans are free to test on this store; regular pricing applies when the store goes live) with the Free card (Unlimited catalog scans, Catalog readiness score, Product-level issue reports, View catalog findings), and Unavailable on dev stores (these plans can't be selected while the store is in development) with Starter $19 / 30 days (100 successful automated fixes a month), Growth $49 / 30 days (1,000) and Scale $99 / 30 days (5,000), each with a greyed out button Not available. The prices agree with the dossier and the listing. Checkout: the only approval screen was for the Free plan: Approve charge, Plan Free, This plan is free. You will not be billed. It was approved (an exception of $0) and no card or payment method was asked. The paid plans could not be selected on the development store, so no Shopify approval screen for a paid plan, no test charge sentence, no tax and no renewal term were seen. Usage and Billing: Current plan Free, Unlimited scans and reports with no AgentNest-applied fixes, Successful fixes 0, Upgrade to apply fixes, a reset on 17 Dec 2026, the sentence that product updates already applied by AgentNest are not reversed after a downgrade or uninstall, and the sentence that AgentNest does not collect payment details. Permissions: already on the Free plan the app asked to view and edit store data (products, orders, Shopify admin), although the Free plan has no applied fixes. Cancelling: on the Free plan there is no paid subscription. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app and Uninstall; the dialog says that you can no longer use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; a reason is required (we chose Testing multiple apps). Not tested: the automatic fixes (paid plans only, not available on the development store), so also what counts as one fix; the scan result, the readiness score and the issue list, because the scan gave nothing; the revenue import and the ChatGPT Ads link. Clean up: the app was uninstalled after the test and left the list of installed apps; our own tabs were closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The first scan gave no result after five clicks and no message; the Free plan already asked for rights to edit store data; the paid plans cannot be selected on a development store, so the unit of a fix was not tested; and the revenue import was not started.
